findings.title: A plan-only PR merges something a Test JS step would have rejected, turning main red
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Correctly notes that the guard skips non-test scripts and runtime-built paths while the PR run is skipped, so main's push run is the first check; the cited release-gate string and the lint-no-dead-package-paths exclusion check out.

findings.title: Required Test JS checks stay Pending on plan-only PRs
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Path-filtered workflows report no checks, so required Test JS checks would stay Pending, as test-eql.yml documents. The repo says no required checks exist today, so the risk is conditional but plausible and introduced by this filter.

findings.title: EQL cutover plan can drift from FROZEN_PUBLISHERS unchecked
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The PR removes the DOCS entry that held the EQL plan to FROZEN_PUBLISHERS, while release-gate.mjs still points operators at that plan's Phase-5 cutover, so the plan can now drift with nothing checking it.
